title: Brusatol Regulates Ferroptosis of Ovarian Cancer Through the Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1 and AKT/mTOR Double Signaling Pathways.
authors: Liu, Hongli; Wang, Luyao; Hu, Mengling; Hua, Jiale; Lian, Xiaofu; Lian, Chaoqun; Zhang, Jing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Brusatol通过Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1和AKT/mTOR通路调控卵巢癌细胞铁死亡，核心是细胞信号通路与铁死亡机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，且方法以湿实验为主，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Ovarian cancer (OC) is a common malignant tumor of the female reproductive system and is usually found at an advanced stage. However, the treatment of OC with conventional the efficacy of surgery and chemotherapy is limited. Brusatol (BRU) is a unique nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) pathway inhibitor with significant anti-cancer effects. At the same time, the Nrf2 system also plays a vital role in ferroptosis, which can be used as a new way to treat tumors. This study investigated the mechanism of action of BRU as a novel ferroptosis inducer to inhibit OC cells. METHODS: Using bioinformatics to screen for key targets and pathways that act on OC in BRU, and then the effects of BRU on OC cells were examined by cell viability assay, clone formation assay, wound healing assay, and apoptosis assay. The intracellular levels of ROS (Reactive Oxygen Species), Fe(2+), glutathione (GSH), and malondialdehyde (MDA) were also quantified. Western blotting analysis was then performed to verify ferroptosis marker proteins and pathways. In addition, the combination of Ferrostatin-1 (Fer-1) and BRU was further tested for ferroptosis-related markers. RESULTS: By obtaining BRU and OC targets, 171 potential BRU-OC action targets were screened to the core target NQO1. KEGG enrichment analysis showed that the anticancer effects of IBC were mediated through multiple pathways, including the PI3K-AKT and Ras signaling pathways. In vitro results showed that IBC inhibited the proliferation, invasion, and migration of OC cells and induced ferroptosis in OC cells. DISCUSSION: We demonstrated that BRU increased intracellular ROS, Fe(2+), and MDA levels. It also significantly reduced intracellular GSH level and the expression of two marker proteins for ferroptosis, GPX4 and SLC7A11. Meanwhile, BRU could inhibit the Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1 and AKT/mTOR dual signaling pathways in OC cells. Furthermore, the combination of Ferrostatin-1 (Fer-1) and BRU reversed BRU-induced ferroptosis in OC cells. CONCLUSION: In this study, we demonstrated for the first time through bioinformatics, molecular docking technology, and experimental validation that BRU acts as a novel inducer of ferroptosis in ovarian cancer cells by targeting the Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1 and AKT/mTOR dual signaling pathways, and may have great potential in the treatment of ovarian cancer cells.
abstract_zh: 引言：卵巢癌（Ovarian cancer, OC）是女性生殖系统常见的恶性肿瘤，通常在晚期才被发现。然而，常规手术和化疗对OC的治疗效果有限。鸦胆子苦醇（Brusatol, BRU）是一种独特的核因子E2相关因子2（nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2, Nrf2）通路抑制剂，具有显著的抗癌作用。同时，Nrf2系统在铁死亡（ferroptosis）中也扮演着重要角色，可作为治疗肿瘤的新途径。本研究探讨了BRU作为新型铁死亡诱导剂抑制OC细胞的机制。方法：利用生物信息学筛选BRU作用于OC的关键靶点和通路，然后通过细胞活力测定、克隆形成实验、伤口愈合实验和凋亡实验检测BRU对OC细胞的影响。同时定量细胞内活性氧（Reactive Oxygen Species, ROS）、Fe(2+)、谷胱甘肽（glutathione, GSH）和丙二醛（malondialdehyde, MDA）水平。随后进行Western blotting分析以验证铁死亡标志蛋白和通路。此外，进一步测试了Ferrostatin-1（Fer-1）与BRU联合使用对铁死亡相关标志物的影响。结果：通过获取BRU和OC靶点，筛选出171个潜在的BRU-OC作用靶点，核心靶点为NQO1。KEGG富集分析显示，IBC的抗癌作用通过多种通路介导，包括PI3K-AKT和Ras信号通路。体外结果表明，IBC抑制OC细胞的增殖、侵袭和迁移，并诱导OC细胞发生铁死亡。讨论：我们证明BRU增加了细胞内ROS、Fe(2+)和MDA水平，同时显著降低了细胞内GSH水平以及铁死亡的两个标志蛋白GPX4和SLC7A11的表达。此外，BRU可抑制OC细胞中的Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1和AKT/mTOR双信号通路。进一步地，Ferrostatin-1（Fer-1）与BRU联合使用逆转了BRU诱导的OC细胞铁死亡。结论：在本研究中，我们首次通过生物信息学、分子对接技术和实验验证证明，BRU通过靶向Nrf2/HO-1/NQO1和AKT/mTOR双信号通路作为卵巢癌细胞的新型铁死亡诱导剂，并可能在卵巢癌细胞治疗中具有巨大潜力。
